ITEM 1 | Dark green spinach leaves, flat and glossy with visible pale green stems, forming a base layer covering most of the white bowl; leaves are whole, about 8-12 cm long, slightly wilted at edges, lying flat with no oil sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-brown oval beans or berries, about 1.5-2 cm long, smooth and slightly glossy skin with wrinkled texture, somewhat firm and whole, scattered over the upper-left and center of the spinach, some with a faint sheen | 110
ITEM 3 | Bright orange shredded carrot, fine julienne strips about 4-6 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, matte with slight moisture, raw-looking with crisp edges, piled loosely in the center-right among the beans and spinach | 45
